cohort_note: SIMULATED competition entrants. Each username is a competition persona bound to exactly one published strategy slice (a transparent filter over the parent strategy's exported backtest records). Entrant performance is re-derived deterministically from the same rows visible in the Ledger tab — no games, prices, fills, results or PnL are invented for any entrant. Career aggregates are the parent strategy's all-history snapshot values.
